narrative.overview:
This scoped record captures the finished shared-picture extension inside the established compact, Cloudflare-inspired blue application UI. It extends the incumbent visual authority; it does not establish a new product-wide visual identity. Source values below are shared by Auth, Mail, and Rok. Light and dark frontmatter entries record the existing theme counterparts; components consume the active semantic CSS variables.

Pictures add recognition to existing account and sender information. Auth owns editing, while Mail and Rok keep their familiar task layouts. The avatar is supporting identity information rather than a badge of trust.
keyCharacteristics: Compact sans typography and sentence-case actions.
Blue actions and focus on neutral, bordered surfaces.
Circular pictures and initials with equivalent layout footprints.
One Auth editor with quiet reuse in each application.

rules.name: The Role-Owned Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation belongs to the floating component role; picture presence does not add elevation.

rules.name: The Equivalent Footprint Rule
rules.body: Loading, missing, failed, and removed pictures retain the image state's circle and allocated space.

rules.name: The Address Remains Rule
rules.body: A sender picture supplements the sender address and never indicates sender verification.

dos: Do reuse the same circular Avatar and equivalent initials fallback across all three apps.
Do keep Auth as the single editor and link to it from Mail settings and the Rok Workspace header.
Do preserve labelled native crop controls, visible focus, inline feedback, and the pending crop after a failed save.
Do retain sender addresses beside pictures and preserve the active theme's semantic colors.
donts: Don't turn a user picture into a verified-sender badge.
Don't add decorative elevation or public-page corner brackets to profile surfaces.
Don't treat the synthetic solid-color screenshot fixtures as product assets or brand colors.
